blocks.prompt: 5 Prove that the points whose position vectors are \(A(-6\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + 2\underline{k})\), \(B(3\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 4\underline{k})\), \(C(5\underline{i} + 7\underline{j} + 3\underline{k})\), \(D(-13\underline{i} + 17\underline{j} - \underline{k})\) are coplanar.
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa vectors nahi, chaar points (nuqte) diye hain, aur dikhana hai ke chaaron ek hi plane mein hain.
Diya kya hai? \(A, B, C, D\) ke position vectors.
Saabit kya karna hai? Chaaron points coplanar hain.
Rule kaunsa? Points se pehle vectors banane parte hain: ek point \(A\) se baqi teeno tak \(\overrightarrow{AB}, \overrightarrow{AC}, \overrightarrow{AD}\). Agar yeh teen vectors coplanar hon to chaaron points bhi.
Plan: teen vectors, phir un ka determinant, aur dikhana ke woh 0 hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A, B, C, D\) ke position vectors.
Humein saabit karna hai: \(A, B, C, D\) coplanar hain.
Tareeqa: Chaar points ek plane mein tabhi hain jab \(A\) se nikalne wale teeno vectors us plane mein hon, yani \([\overrightarrow{AB}\ \overrightarrow{AC}\ \overrightarrow{AD}] = 0\). Kyun? Agar \(D\) us plane se bahar hota to \(A\) se bane in teen edges par dabbe ki kuch height hoti aur volume 0 nahi hota.

\(A\) se teen vectors banayein
\[\overrightarrow{AB} = 9\underline{i} - 5\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{AC} = 11\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} + \underline{k}\]
\[\overrightarrow{AD} = -7\underline{i} + 14\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) = (B ka position vector) \(-\) (A ka position vector), yani "aakhri minus pehla". Misaal: \(3 - (-6) = 9\), \(-2 - 3 = -5\), \(4 - 2 = 2\). Isi tarah \(\overrightarrow{AC}\): \(5 + 6 = 11\), \(7 - 3 = 4\), \(3 - 2 = 1\); aur \(\overrightarrow{AD}\): \(-13 + 6 = -7\), \(17 - 3 = 14\), \(-1 - 2 = -3\).
Dhyan dein: \(-(-6)\) plus 6 hota hai; yahan sign ki ghalti poora sawal bigaar deti hai.

Nateeja aur tasdeeq
\[\overrightarrow{AD} = -2\overrightarrow{AB} + \overrightarrow{AC}\]
\[-18 + 11 = -7,\ 10 + 4 = 14,\ -4 + 1 = -3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Triple product 0 hai, is liye teeno vectors aur chaaron points coplanar hain. Tasdeeq: \(\overrightarrow{AD}\) ko \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{AC}\) ke mel se bana sakte hain, to \(D\) unhi ke plane mein hai.
blocks.final_answer: \([\overrightarrow{AB}\ \overrightarrow{AC}\ \overrightarrow{AD}] = 0\). Saabit ho gaya: \(A, B, C, D\) coplanar hain.
